lines: By the time the ferry reached the island,
the morning fog had begun to lift.
A shopkeeper was arranging fresh bread
in the window opposite the landing stage.
We bought two rolls and asked for directions
to the footpath along the eastern shore.
She drew a quick map on a paper bag,
adding a star beside a sheltered beach.
That small gesture changed our plans,
and we spent the afternoon by the water.
